chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Kaiser Marshall's hand cymbal
summary: He recalls Kaiser Marshall's exciting playing with a hand cymbal beaten with a stick.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: And Don Redman. He had so many guys. Then they had Kaiser. Kaiser was real great then, and very exciting in them days. He had a hand cymbal that he used to use. You know? I never see any more as those. You know, the same as a foot cymbal, the same as a hi-hat thing...?
Well, he'd have this in his hand, and play that.
Yeah. He played it... He beat on with a stick.
Yeah, I think he'd take some breaks like that.
Yeah. Uh-huh. They were real great. I mean, they were exciting.
